title: Zombie Debt: Your Dead Debt Can Rise Again
hook: Your old debt legally died — but collectors buy it for pennies and one word from you resurrects it for 7 more years.
angle: Zombie debt is an $88B industry built on fear. Collectors buy expired debt for 1-4 cents on the dollar, then pressure you into a 'good faith' payment that legally restarts the statute of limitations — turning a dead debt back into a live one.
audience: Anyone 25-45 who has had debt go to collections, especially old credit card or medical debt
key_numbers: $88 billion — size of the zombie debt market
1–4 cents — what collectors pay per dollar of your old debt
7 years — how long debt stays on your credit report
1 payment — all it takes to restart the statute of limitations
3–7 years — statute of limitations window by state
